name: Archive and Restore
description: Implement workspace archival: compress workspace state (identity, metadata, config, session history, artifact registry), detach repositories (optionally stash work), and free filesystem resources. Restore reverses the process: decompress state, re-attach repositories, restore worktrees, and restore session context. Support full and partial restore.
purpose: Workspaces accumulate state over time — artifacts, sessions, caches. Archival packs this state into a portable format and frees resources. Restore brings the workspace back exactly as it was, enabling long-term project hibernation and workspace portability.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive compresses workspace state: identity, metadata, config, session history, artifact registry
Archive detaches repositories with option to stash uncommitted work before detach
Archive frees worktree filesystem resources (worktree directory removed)
Archive produces a single portable file (format: .tribunus-workspace or tar.gz)
Restore decompresses workspace state back to original location or new location
Restore re-attaches repositories (clones if remote, re-creates worktrees)
Restore recovers stashed work from archive
Partial restore: select which components to restore (state only, without re-cloning repos)
